name: Unfinished
source:
A nice little story to snack on, where you play as a lonely anxiety-ridden artist who brought three women to life, and you get a peek into how things are going to play out going forward.

[From [url=https://erosnocturne.itch.io/unfinished]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个不错的小故事，你扮演一个孤独、焦虑的艺术家，将三个女人带入了生活，你可以一睹事情的未来发展。

[来自[url=https://erosnocturne.itch.io/unfinished]itch.io[/url]]
